points.description: First privileged action correctly named with its technical term AND explained with its effect. Accepted actions from the model answer: writing to CR3 (changes page directory pointer); writing to EFLAGS (changes execution status such as zero bit / interrupt enable-disable); writing to IDTR (changes location of the IDT); accessing a virtual address in the kernel virtual address range.
points.partial_credit: Half only if the action is named precisely (correct register or kernel-VA access) but the explanation of its effect is missing or incomplete.

points.description: Second, different privileged action from the same accepted list, correctly named with its technical term AND explained with its effect.
points.partial_credit: Half only if the action is named precisely but the explanation of its effect is missing or incomplete.

rubric.notes: Each of the two required actions must be a distinct item from the model answer (CR3 write, EFLAGS write, IDTR write, kernel-VA access), named with the correct register or term and with its effect explained. Vague answers such as "access hardware" or "change memory" earn nothing, and a wrong action or an action the user process could legally do (e.g. updating a PCB it cannot see) earns nothing for that point. If a student lists more than two and one is wrong, the wrong extra item costs a point.
